complete.problem: Use the sine rule to find side b. In the triangle, side a = 4 is opposite angle A = 30 degrees, and angle B = 60 degrees. Write the rule: a / sin A = b / sin B, so 4 / sin 30 degrees = b / sin 60 degrees. Rearrange: b = (4 x sin 60 degrees) / sin 30 degrees = (4 x 0.8660) / 0.5 = 6.928, so b is about 6.93. Check: the side opposite the larger angle (60 degrees) is longer than the side opposite 30 degrees, and 6.93 is greater than 4, so the size makes sense.
